snippet.title: Relics of the Past [v3.0.0] - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
#breathofthewild  #botw  #relicsofthepast  #zeldamods  
Special thanks to @tubofpho! And @JaySkilling for help with the thumbnail!
———
Upon the sealing of the first calamity, Ganon began to quiver within the sacred realm where his spirit lies to this day. His army had failed him, and the people of Hyrule had turned over his army once more. The citizens of the land were celebrating over the death of the demon king, only to know that he would inevitably return one day. They were so confident, so blissful, and so unaware of what was to come. 10,000 years passed, and the calamity's resurrection was foretold by a prophet. The people unearthed the ancient Divine Beasts, trained their armies for something that had happened once before, and were met with shock and despair. Ganon swept away the army of Hyrule, took over the divine beasts, took the lives of the champions and the life of the hero. A century has passed since the events of the Calamity, and Ganon has deployed every last force he can possibly manifest across the fields of Hyrule. Every Guardian left roaming, every Lynel left controlling, all in the hope that the hero would never succeed in fulfilling his destiny; but the hero did not falter. The century had given Link enough time to heal his wounds and grant him the unmatched strength that he once had. Upon leaving the shrine where he slept, he was greeted by a terrorized world full of the things that had taken his life so long ago. He has only one goal, to take back the lands of Hyrule before the guardians did. Does he have what it takes?
———
Special thanks to everyone who helped me with this, along with the Relics of the Past team who made this mod! Full credit will be below. Sorry I couldn't put everyone at the end! There were so many names and it wouldn't fit on one screen!
This took over 40 hours to make so a like and a sub is appreciated :)
